description: S0 in-distribution evaluation: the training objects and ranges with a different seed (new draws inside the training ranges), 32 worlds per object.
status: 2026-11-11: simulation setting chosen for this run: component-wise 50 N force and 5 N m torque limits for every object. Not a real-robot safety threshold; the Mini45-based limit is still to be set. Material scales are a simulation design range, not a measured calibration.
sim_dt_note: 2026-11-11: potato_003 uses DiSECt substep 8e-6 s (scenes default 1e-5 s). At 1e-5 s its mesh is unstable from step 1 at Young x2 / density x0.8 (inside the S0 range); at 8e-6 s it is stable up to Young x3 / density x0.8 with the same reference-cut peak forces (within 0.1 N). See RESULTS.md.
